standard_prerequisites.name: Finite in a neighbourhood
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes p finite near the fibre.

standard_prerequisites.name: Flatness criterion
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes p flat near the fibre.

core_obligations: Shrink so p is finite and flat with fibre an isomorphism; p is open and surjective after shrinking.
The sheaf map p^sharp becomes an isomorphism on the fibre; Nakayama makes it surjective near the fibre, so p is a closed immersion after shrinking.
A surjective flat closed immersion of Noetherian schemes is an isomorphism.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to finite flat, push to a closed immersion by Nakayama, conclude.
difficulty_reason: Finite-flat reduction with Nakayama and a closed immersion finish; fully displayed.
